name: Jimmy Emmons
bio: Jimmy Emmons edited the Dakota Blade, which in late 1884 and early 1885 argued against repealing the herd law in the Bad Lands. The Cow Boy answered that he had never been in the Bad Lands and that no one there had petitioned for repeal.

moments.label: Cow Boy rebutted his Dakota Blade herd-law argument
